title: Haunted Gloop Trifle
inspiration: make it a revolting fake DESSERT (a custard, pie, trifle, jelly or cake that is obviously not food), inspired by 1980s kids' film ghost slime and ectoplasm

title: Churchyard Squash Trifle
inspiration: make it a savoury dish, not a dessert (if the inspiration below is sweet, find a savoury dish in the same spirit), inspired by a graveyard trifle or 'dirt' pudding for a Halloween party; lean on what's in season now in Europe: pumpkin and squash, apples, pears, chestnuts, mushrooms
